marginalia.note: Nullum hic argumentum à majori, sed collatio impa-rium axio-matica.

page.notes: Printed "Nonjam ut servum" appears set without a space between "Nonjam" and "ut"; copied as printed. Note text "impa-rium axio-matica" is a hyphenated split across lines; read as "imparium axiomatica" but the hyphens are copied as printed. The word "distributionem" and "obscurius" are clear. The catchword "prà" is the start of the next page's first word "supra" printed at right below the text.
